mapper.insert: insert into audit_logs ( id, event_type, user_id, email, client_ip, reason, occurred_at, consumed_at, kafka_topic, kafka_key, payload_json ) values ( cast(#{id} as uuid), #{eventType}, cast(#{userId} as uuid), #{email}, #{clientIp}, #{reason}, #{occurredAt}, #{consumedAt}, #{kafkaTopic}, #{kafkaKey}, #{payloadJson} )
